t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnome comes in pairs. Certain coloured paired gnomes would take you to different forests. It could be bright or dark forests.The yield of mushrooms varies depending on what kind of forest you are in.

vb_textbox.text: The best advice I can give you is to pick the left Gnome every time.Be quick to select the Gnome and press space once the basket appears.The less miss you have the less chance you will lose points.You might also not get any points of picking all the right decisions but it is rare. So, Good Luck and have some fun while playing the game :)
